title: Gluing effectivity from affine bases
statement: Let $P$ be a property of morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] preserved by every chosen second pullback projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. Assume that for every singleton fpqc covering $f:X\to A$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering] with $A$ affine, every descent datum $D$ on $V\to X$ [def-pd-descent-datum] with $P(V\to X)$ is effective. Then the same conclusion holds for every singleton fpqc covering $f:X\to S$ without an affine-base assumption.

source.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, general-base proof, affine-open restriction and relative gluing

proof.text: Pull back the covering and datum to each affine open A of S. The covering stays fpqc and P is preserved; the affine-base hypothesis produces an effective object W_A.

source.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, general-base proof, affine-open restriction and relative gluing

proof.text: For B contained in A compare the effective objects over B through their canonical identifications after fpqc pullback. Unique descent of morphisms gives inverse transition maps; uniqueness proves composition and identity, and identifies each transition square as a pullback.

source.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, general-base proof, affine-open restriction and relative gluing

proof.text: Relative gluing on the directed affine cover constructs W over S. Glue the compatible local identifications of W times_S X with V and their inverses. Their transport equations hold locally and hence globally, giving an invariant pullback projection V to W.

theorem fpqc_effectivity_of_affine_bases (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    (hbase : ∀ {Y V V' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ V) (h : V' ⟶ V),
      P g → P (pullback.snd g h))
    (hlocal : ∀ {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] (f : X ⟶ S),
      Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S →
      ∀ {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum f V), P V.hom → D.IsEffective)
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hf : Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum f V) (hV : P V.hom) : D.IsEffective
